headline: Inside Kevin O'Leary's watch collection
stop_reason: Stopped for owner review. Validation passes (finish PASS, 6 slides). Open issue: the Royal Oak 15202 slide (slide 3) uses a personal wrist snapshot from Wikimedia Commons (OpaleHorse), not an official studio product photo like the Nautilus slide, so the watch-slide photo style does not match (lesson: one photo source type for all watch slides). Also, the Royal Oak is described only as listed by Wristenthusiast (single outlet, reportedly), so it is not on a publishable ownership claim; the caption says reportedly. Research ledgers for the full browser trace were not produced in this unattended run. Prices are not used; the source article is dated 4 January 2022.
